replies.body: You need elevated permissions to apply labels to issues / PRs. We could look at adding a workflow that can add them on behalf of users. Other OTel repos do that based on a comment like "/label {label_name} -{label_name}".

to avoid confusion for contributors trying to add the label?

```suggestion
- [ ] Changelog updated if the change requires an entry
```
